title: GTA 6's first real patch: what it fixed
yt_title: GTA 6's first REAL patch is out 🛠️ Is your bug fixed?
description: Is your GTA 6 bug fixed? The first post-launch patch (01.002.002 on PS5, 1.0.2.2 on Xbox) landed November 23 with real patch notes. It fixes some crashes, weather that stopped changing, autosaves, phone calls that failed to trigger, and a wanted level you couldn't lose (PlayStation LifeStyle, Vice, Push Square). Not in the notes: a first-person mode or a performance mode. A viral post claims a big fix and an apology on November 25: Rockstar hasn't confirmed either, so it's still a rumor. Is your game fixed? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (unconfirmed): a viral X post claims a big fix and a Rockstar apology on Nov 25.
